bm_desc: Disclosure of Voting Results of the Remote E-Voting and Voting at the 80th Annual GeneralMeeting ( AGM ) of the Company held on 30th July 2026
Mahindra & Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on July 30, 2026.

Mahindra & Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated 30th July 2026, titled "Press Release on Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the First Quarter ended 30th June 2026".
Mahindra & Mahindra Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended 30 June 2026.
Approval for Sale, Transfer & Disposal of Company s Truck and Bus Division to SML Mahindra Limited, on a slump sale basis under Business Transfer Agreement
